heading: Rules and regulations
lead: The Secretary is authorized and directed to make such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this subchapter.
sourceCredit: (June 27, 1934, ch. 847, title IX, § 907, as added Sept. 1, 1951, ch. 378, title II, § 201, 65 Stat. 301; amended Pub. L. 90–19, § 1(a)(3), May 25, 1967, 81 Stat. 17.)
